import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Mod {
        long num;

        Mod(long n) {
            num = ((n % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        Mod() {
            num = 0;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(num);
        }
    }

    static Mod add(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod((a.num + b.num) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod sub(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod((a.num - b.num + MOD) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod mul(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return new Mod((a.num * b.num) % MOD);
    }

    static Mod[] modArray = new Mod[1000000];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < modArray.length; i++) {
            modArray[i] = new Mod(i);
        }
    }

    static Mod modPow(Mod base, int exp) {
        Mod res = new Mod(1);
        Mod b = new Mod(base.num);
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = mul(res, b);
            b = mul(b, b);
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static Mod modInv(Mod a) {
        return modPow(a, (int) (MOD - 2));
    }

    static Mod div(Mod a, Mod b) {
        return mul(a, modInv(b));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;

        Mod[][] pers = new Mod[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                pers[i][j] = new Mod(0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < s; ++i) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }

        for (int i = s; i < s + N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = s; j < s + N; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                pers[i][j] = div(new Mod(p), new Mod(100));
            }
        }

        for (int i = s + N; i < 6; ++i) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }

        // Generate all permutations of {0,0,0,1,1,1}
        int[] v = {0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1};
        Map<Integer, Integer> permMap = new HashMap<>();
        int id = 0;
        do {
            int mask = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                if (v[k] == 1) mask |= (1 << k);
            }
            permMap.put(mask, id++);
        } while (nextPermutation(v));

        // Lambda for solving
        Mod[] upper = solve(pers, 0);
        Mod[] lower = solve(pers, 3);

        // FWT-style summation for lower
        for (int bit = 1; bit < (1 << 20); bit <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
                if ((i & bit) == 0) {
                    lower[i ^ bit] = add(lower[i ^ bit], lower[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask) {
            if (upper[mask].num == 0) continue;

            int need = 0;
            for (int x = 0; x < 20; ++x) {
                if ((mask & (1 << x)) != 0) {
                    need |= (1 << (19 - x));
                }
            }

            int complement = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ need;
            Mod term = mul(upper[mask], sub(new Mod(1), lower[complement]));
            answer = add(answer, term);
        }

        System.out.println(answer.num);
    }

    static Mod[] solve(Mod[][] pers, int offset) {
        Mod[] result = new Mod[1 << 20];
        for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
            result[i] = new Mod(0);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            int[][] haves = new int[3][6];
            Mod prob = new Mod(1);

            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    int idx = i * 6 + j;
                    if ((mask & (1 << idx)) != 0) {
                        haves[i][j] = 1;
                        prob = mul(prob, pers[offset + i][j]);
                    } else {
                        prob = mul(prob, sub(new Mod(1), pers[offset + i][j]));
                    }
                }
            }

            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
                if (haves[0][i] == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (haves[1][j] == 0) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                        if (haves[2][k] == 0) continue;
                        if (i == k || j == k) continue;
                        int anum = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                        if (permMap.containsKey(anum)) {
                            flags |= (1 << permMap.get(anum));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            result[flags] = add(result[flags], prob);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }

        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }

        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;

        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
}
